name: tracegrab
description: Prove AI-changed code still behaves correctly at runtime. Drive handlers with sequenced API calls, trace the real data flow, diff behavior against a baseline, and gate the change on it.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run compile
scripts.build:webview: npm --prefix webview-ui install && npm --prefix webview-ui run build
scripts.test: npm run lint:boundaries && npm run compile && node verify/host-logic.test.mjs && node verify/call-tree.test.mjs && node verify/recursion-depth.test.mjs && node verify/safety.test.mjs && node verify/flowtrace.test.mjs && node verify/behavioral-diff.test.mjs && node verify/contracts.test.mjs && node verify/outcome.test.mjs && node verify/breakpoints.test.mjs && node verify/session-status.test.mjs && node cli/collector.test.mjs && node cli/collector-interactive.test.mjs && node cli/headless-session.test.mjs && node verify/headless-mcp.test.mjs
